title: go.mod marks the directly imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:15 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 // indirect` while store.go:7 imports `_ "modernc.org/sqlite"` directly; go.mod has no direct require block
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency is listed without the // indirect marker

title: Oversized or trailing-garbage request bodies are not distinguished from malformed JSON
evidence: handlers.go:53 `http.MaxBytesReader(nil, r.Body, 1<<20)` and handlers.go:56-57 map every decode error to 400 "invalid JSON body" (no 413); a single dec.Decode call also accepts trailing data after the first JSON value
suggestion: Return 413 on *http.MaxBytesError and reject trailing tokens after the first JSON value
